definitions.gloss: exposition; statement of one's argument; written discussion
definitions.explanation: The act of presenting and developing an argument or viewpoint in a systematic, logical manner, typically in writing. Often used in academic and examination contexts.

examples.japanese: {論述|ろんじゅつ}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To prepare for an essay exam.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{論理的|ろんりてき}→論理的：05672_ronriteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{論述|ろんじゅつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: The ability to present your ideas logically is required.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{賛成|さんせい}→賛成：02829_sansei⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{明確|めいかく}→明確：01664_meikaku⟧にして{論述|ろんじゅつ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: For this assignment, please clearly state your position for or against and present your argument.

notes: Used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form {論述|ろんじゅつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to expound, to present an argument). Common collocations: {論述|ろんじゅつ}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧ (essay exam), {論述|ろんじゅつ}⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ (essay question), {論述|ろんじゅつ}{式|しき} (essay-type format). Primarily found in academic and examination settings. Related: ⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧ (thesis, academic paper — the finished product), ⟦{記述|きじゅつ}→記述：05819_kijutsu⟧ (description — broader, not necessarily argumentative), ⟦{論証|ろんしょう}→論証：21103_ronshou⟧ (demonstration, proof — focuses on proving a point).
